cohort: Pregnant women, with and without inflammatory myopathies (IM), identified from the Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project - Nationwide Inpatient Sample (HCUP-NIS) database from 1999 to 2015
finding: Pregnant women with IM had increased risks of adverse maternal outcomes, including preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, infections, and longer hospital stays, as well as adverse neonatal outcomes, including prematurity, small for gestational age, and intrauterine fetal demise.
